title: temper build args
description: Reference schema for the args passed to the build workflow (stage 3). The workflow's validateBuildArgs is the enforcing check; it also refuses two tasks in one wave owning the same path, a task using a contract no earlier wave provides, an answer for an unknown task, and an ssh host clone inside <root>/<epic>/.

default_branch.description: The repo's default branch (origin/HEAD without its remote). The workflows refuse a branch that names it or the base, however either is spelled: refs/heads/, heads/, refs/remotes/<remote>/, remotes/<remote>/, origin/ and upstream/ are stripped and case is folded.

build_rule.description: Optional. The project's build rule (project.md's ## Build rule), passed to every agent as data.

attempt.description: Optional. The build's attempt counter, bumped on every resume; missing means 0. It ends the checkpoint and later phase prompts, so a resume reruns them live.

flaky.description: Optional. Known flaky tests (project.md's flaky:), which a quick gate may rerun once.

task_checks.description: Optional. each (the default) runs a checker after every implementer, with one retry; none leaves review to stage 4's sweep.

gate_slots.description: Optional. How many of a wave's tasks run at once: the wave is chunked to this size, with one merge per wave. Missing means the whole wave at once.

stop_after.description: Optional. Where the build returns status stopped, with {at, done_now, commits, flaky_reruns}. It reaches no prompt, so a later launch without it replays what this one ran. The workflow also refuses a wave no task is in.

impl_cause.description: Optional. true adds an optional cause enum to the implementer schema and one line to its prompt; a blocked entry keeps a listed cause.

baseline.description: Optional. launch runs the baseline gate on tip once, in a throwaway worktree, before the first wave with pending tasks. A red tip returns blocked {id: baseline, cause: base-red} before any implementer. off or missing runs nothing.

tip.description: The epic branch's sha this launch is for, read by the head. Required when baseline is launch: a branch at any other commit blocks with cause tip-mismatch.

baseline_attempt.description: Optional. Ends the baseline prompt, so bumping it reruns the check when the tip hasn't moved. Missing means 0.

owns_widen.description: Optional. Lets an implementer ask for files outside its owns once in a run. With it absent, schemas and prompts don't mention it. Also refused: a path of the wrong shape, one under the built-in protected globs, and one a same-wave task owns or widened.

max.description: At most this many paths per request. Missing means 3, and more than 3 is refused.

protected.description: The project's protected globs (project.md's owns_protected), using only * ** and ?. A name with no slash means that path at the repo root: write **/name for any depth.

owns_widened.description: Optional. What earlier launches widened: the run skill appends each result's owns_widened entries, so a relaunch can't widen a task twice and the merge still checks its paths.

clone.description: The repo's clone on the host (project.md's host_clone), outside <root>/<epic>/. The head fetches the epic and task branches back from ssh://<name>/<clone> (amendment A7).

baseline.description: Optional. The gate the baseline agent runs; missing means quick.
